title: Genomic DNA Extraction from Cells
author: Bao Thai
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.nk4dcyw
materials: Put PCR tubes in thermocycler: 20min at 65C, 20min at 95C, store at -20C.

steps.title: Prepare Quick Extract buffer
steps.instruction: Obtain Quick Extract buffer (QE, Epibio catalog #QE09050) and keep it on ice until use.

steps.title: Remove cell culture media
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard all culture medium from the cells.

steps.title: Centrifuge cells first time
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the plate at 16,000 × g for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Wash cells with ice‑cold PBS
steps.instruction: Add ice‑cold 1× PBS to each well to wash the cells.

steps.title: Centrifuge cells second time
steps.instruction: Centrifuge again at 16,000 × g for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Add Quick Extract buffer to wells
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of QE buffer to each well (for 24‑well plates; scale proportionally for other plate sizes).

steps.title: Transfer lysate to PCR tubes
steps.instruction: Transfer the 100 µL lysate from each well into individual PCR tubes (100 µL per tube).

steps.title: Vortex and centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Mix each tube by vortexing then collect the liquid at the bottom by brief centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge briefly to collect liquid at the bottom

steps.title: Measure DNA concentration
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer, using QE buffer as the blank.
